parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database you want to back up.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds enable-sql-flashback-match-switch --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --db-name test --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
